title: Choose bounded renderer for effects
prompt: Create an interactive particle field with a custom image displacement effect behind semantic hero content.

rubricDimensions.pass: chooses SVG/Canvas/Pixi/WebGL/WebGPU by effect complexity and support
rubricDimensions.fail: uses GPU renderer for simple decoration

rubricDimensions.pass: caps DPR, objects, delta time and pauses when hidden
provides deterministic static and semantic paths

negativeControls.name: desktop capture
negativeControls.input: Effect appears smooth on developer desktop

negativeControls.name: shader similarity
negativeControls.mustNot: copy unique artwork or assert the same shader implementation

baseline.withoutSkill: adds a heavy canvas with no measurement
baseline.withSkill: documents renderer, deterministic test, fallback and device budget
